text:
I haven't changed anything, because this app can't do that.

- **No archive action.** A contact's status can only be new, pending, accepted or declined. Declining is a different thing, so I won't use it as a stand-in.
- **No way to select by reply date.** I can select by company, by status, or by a named contact. I can't select by when someone last replied, so I couldn't pick out the six-month group reliably.

Here are two things I can do instead:
- Decline a specific group, such as one company's pending contacts. I'll check the count with you before I commit.
- Open contacts and read their activity history, so you can identify who has gone quiet.

Tell me if you want either one, or if "decline" is what you meant by "archive".
